title: skiller skill evals (evals.json / pressure.json / triggers.json)
description: Registry skill behavioral tests (eval-first). Lie in skills/<bucket>/<name>/evals/. Runner/grader — lib/skiller/eval.py (skiller eval). Manual runtime validation (validate.sh + eval.validate_*); scheme - for DX. evals/ is NOT a vendor or part of content-hash.

assertion.description: Deterministic run output check (without LLM-judge — reproducible in CI).

case_sensitive.description: Comparison is case insensitive by default (natural language is more robust).

id.description: Unique case identifier in the file.

prompt.description: Request in the user's real language (specifics: paths, names).

tempts.description: Only for pressure: which is tempting the agent to do it, MISSING the skill.

files.description: Files written to workspace before the run.

evals.description: evals.json — positive cases (what the skill should do).

pressure.description: pressure.json — temptation scenarios (TDD for documentation): withhold behavior under pressure.

triggers.description: triggers.json — response accuracy description (tier-0): should_trigger vs should_not.
